Name: New Skin Tones
Author: prettypinktardis
Description:
[size=3]this is my very first mod so i decided to do something simple: new skin tones for the farmer!

- download and open the file with a .rar extraction tool
- copy and paste the file into: Stardew Valley\Content\Characters\Farmer
- overwrite when asked

i haven't tested it in game other than in the character creation menu. let me know if anything looks weird and i'll fix it when i have time! :)[/size]
